what_the_readings_rule_out: the worker is NOT absent for a returning client: A/A2 show one registration on scope "/" with active+controller = /v10-sw.js, and the page is controlled (True)

the offline failure is NOT 'the app rendered then broke': B got page.goto: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at http://127.0.0.1:4441/v8/hub -- the browser itself answered, so no worker served that navigation at all

the precache is NOT merely missing an entry: CacheStorage for the origin is EMPTY ([]), while the built worker does carry the workbox calls (v10-sw.js: precacheAndRoute=1, NavigationRoute=1, createHandlerBoundToURL=1, index.html=3)

generated_worker_config.note: the allowlist pattern names /v8 and /index -- the bare root "/" is NOT listed, which is a separate reading from the deep-link case and is recorded here rather than inferred

which_worker_the_shipped_app_registers.consequence: the only shipped worker is the generated one; the worker that actually owns a cache and a /v8/live fallback is registered in DEV only, so a production client cannot use it

which_layer_owns_what_still_unresolved.B_returning_client: owned by the generated worker's install: its precache never materialises (0 caches). Whether that is an install-time throw, a manifest/URL mismatch, or the legacy-cache cleanup deleting what workbox just wrote is the FIRST thing an implementation order must answer -- and answering it needs the worker's own console/install outcome, which this read-only pass did not capture
which_layer_owns_what_still_unresolved.root_navigation: a ruling, not a bug: the fallback allowlist does not name "/", so even a healthy precache may still leave the bare root unanswered. Needs the commander/arbiter to say which document the root should serve
which_layer_owns_what_still_unresolved.C_never_visited: no app layer can fix this: with nothing installed there is nothing to intercept. The only candidates are distribution-layer (a static page served before the app exists, or the deploy root) or product-scope (accept that a first visit must be online). Do not fold this into B's fix, and do not count it as an ORD-0263 sibling
